text: Q 1 red onion, cut in half and then thinly sliced Q bring to a boil 1.5 ¢ water and 1.5 ¢ white vinegar with a pinch of salt and a good squeeze of honey Q add hot liquid to jars with sliced onions in them Q leave uncovered 1 hr and then cover and refrigerate - ready to eat in 30 min or you can leave overnight!
